gen.title: How seats are shared among states

cards.stem: In what year was the current method for sharing seats adopted?
How many seats are in the House of Representatives in total?
cards.quote: Each of the 50 states is given one seat out of the current total of 435.

cards.stem: How is the multiplier for a seat calculated?
options: 1 divided by the square root of n(n-1)
1 divided by the square root of 2(2-1)
1 divided by the square root of 3(3-1)
1 divided by the square root of 4(4-1)
cards.quote: 1 divided by the square root of n(n-1)

cards.stem: How often must the count be conducted after the first meeting?
cards.quote: and within every subsequent Term of ten Years, in such Manner as they shall by Law direct.
